breakdown.deepRead:
Pablo watches the investor turn each calm review into an emergency. The calls are not just tiring. They teach the team to scan for panic before they scan for facts.

The move is to limit exposure before the mood spreads. Pablo keeps the useful update, moves it to one written note, and stops giving crisis a live stage.

Bad luck is not the danger here. Repeated drama is. If one person rewards every spark with alarm, the group starts to copy the alarm. Distance protects judgment.
